title: Namaz of Imam Ali Ameer ul Momineen (a.s.)
categoryChain: Namaz of Imam Ali Ameer ul Momineen (a.s.)
introduction:
NAMAZ OF IMAM ALI (A.S.)

Shaykh al-Tusi and Sayyid Ibn Tawus have recorded that Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq (a.s.) said: One who offers the four-unit prayer of Ameer al-Momineen Imam Ali (a.s.) will be as free of sins as newborns and will have all his requests granted. Numerous narrations mention splendid rewards for offering this prayer on Fridays.

verses.translation: In each unit, recite Surah al-Faatehah once and repeat Surah al-Tawheed fifty times. On accomplishment, say the following litany of Imam Ali (a.s.):
Glory be to Him Whose signs never perish.
Glory be to Him Whose reserves never downgrade.
Glory be to Him Whose honor never vanishes.

verses.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لَا يَنْفَدُ مَا عِنْدَهُ
verses.translation: Glory be to Him Whose possessions never run out.
Glory be to Him Whose duration (of existence) is never interrupted.

verses.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لَا يُشَارِكُ اَحَدًا فِي اَمْرِهِ
verses.translation: Glory be to Him Who never betakes to Himself a partner in His affairs.
Glory be to Him save Whom there is no god

verses.arabic: يَا مَنْ عَفَا عَنِ السَّيِّئَاتِ وَ لَمْ يُجَازِ بِهَا
verses.translation: O He who overlooks sins and does not inflict punishment in return,
(please) have mercy on Your servant, O Allah,
that is I myself, that is I myself.
I am Your servant, O my Chief,

verses.arabic: اَنَا عَبْدُكَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ اَيَا رَبَّاهُ،
verses.translation: I am Your servant; I am at Your disposal; O my Lord.
O my God, in the name of Your Being, O my Hope,
O my All-beneficent, O my Supporter,
Your servant, Your servant, has no strategy.
O Ultimate of my desire!
O He Who makes blood run into the veins of Your slave!
O my Chief, O my Master!

verses.arabic: اَيَا هُوَ اَيَا هُوَ يَا رَبَّاهُ
verses.translation: O He Who is Unique! O He Who is Unique! o my Lord!
I am Your servant, Your servant-

verses.arabic: لَا حِيْلَةَ لِيْ وَ لَا غِنٰى بِيْ عَنْ نَفْسِيْ
verses.translation: have no strategy and I cannot avail myself

verses.arabic: وَ لَا اَسْتَطِيْعُ لَهَا ضَرًّا وَ لَا نَفْعًا
verses.translation: and I have no control over loss or over profit.
I do not find anyone from whom I may seek help;
so, all profitable avenues have been blocked,
and all my expectations have turned into disappointments.
Helpless and forsaken I came to You,
So, I have presented myself before You in this current stand.

verses.arabic: يَا اِلٰهِيْ بِعِلْمِكَ كَانَ هٰذَا كُلُّهُ
verses.translation: O my God, You are aware of all that which I speak about.
So, how would You deal with me?

verses.arabic: وَ لَيْتَ شِعْرِيْ كَيْفَ تَقُوْلُ لِدُعَاۤئِي
verses.translation: If I but knew how would You dispense with my prayer?

verses.arabic: اَ تَقُوْلُ نَعَمْ اَمْ تَقُوْلُ لَا،
verses.translation: Would You say, ‘Yes’ or ‘No’?

verses.arabic: فَاِنْ قُلْتَ لَا فَيَا وَيْلِيْ يَا وَيْلِيْ يَا وَيْلِيْ
verses.translation: If You say ‘No,’ then I am ruined! I am ruined! I am ruined!

verses.arabic: يَا عَوْلِيْ يَا عَوْلِيْ يَا عَوْلِيْ
verses.translation: Woe to me! Woe to me! Woe to me!

verses.arabic: يَا شِقْوَتِيْ يَا شِقْوَتِيْ يَا شِقْوَتِيْ
verses.translation: Oh my misery! Oh my misery! Oh my misery!

verses.arabic: يَا ذُلِّيْ يَا ذُلِّيْ يَا ذُلِّيْ
verses.translation: Oh my ill-luck! Oh my ill-luck! Oh my ill-luck!
To whom? By Whom?

verses.arabic: اَوْ عِنْدَ مَنْ اَوْ كَيْفَ اَوْ مَا ذَا
verses.translation: From whom? How? What?
In which place to take shelter?
For whom shall I hope?

verses.arabic: وَ مَنْ يَجُوْدُ عَلَيَّ بِفَضْلِهِ حِيْنَ تَرْفُضُنِيْ
verses.translation: Who shall bestow upon me with his favor when You forsake me?
O Liberal in forgiveness!

verses.arabic: وَ اِنْ قُلْتَ نَعَمْ كَمَا هُوَ الظَّنُّ بِكَ وَ الرَّجَاۤءُ لَكَ
verses.translation: But if You say ‘Yes,’ as I expect You to say and as I desire from You,

verses.arabic: فَطُوْبٰى لِيْ اَنَا السَّعِيْدُ وَ اَنَا الْمَسْعُوْدُ
verses.translation: then joy is for me, I am successful, I am happy;
then joy is for me, I will receive (Your) mercy.
O Ever-merciful! O Ever-compassionate!
O Ever-sympathetic! O Ever- commiserating!
o Ever-sovereign! O Just!

verses.arabic: لَا عَمَلَ لِيْ اَبْلُغُ بِهِ نَجَاحَ حَاجَتِيْ
verses.translation: I lack any act due to which I can attain achievement of my desire.

verses.arabic: اَسْاَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِيْ جَعَلْتَهُ فِي مَكْنُوْنِ غَيْبِكَ
verses.translation: I thus beseech You in the name of Your Name which You have reserved in the innermost of Your Hidden Knowledge

verses.arabic: وَ اسْتَقَرَّ عِنْدَكَ فَلَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْكَ اِلٰى شَيْ‏ءٍ سِوَاكَ
verses.translation: and it has thus settled with You so firmly that nothing of it can come out from You to any other thing.

verses.arabic: اَسْاَلُكَ بِهِ وَ بِكَ وَ بِهِ فَاِنَّهُ اَجَلُّ وَ اَشْرَفُ اَسْمَاۤئِكَ
verses.translation: I beseech You by it and by You, for it is certainly the most exalted and honored of Your Names.
I have nothing to mention except this,

verses.arabic: وَ لَا اَحَدَ اَعْوَدُ عَلَيَّ مِنْكَ
verses.translation: and no one can be more beneficent to me than You.
O Absolute Being! O Creator of creation!
O He Who has introduced Himself to me!
O He Who has commanded me to obey Him!
O He Who has warned me against disobeying Him!
O He Who is besought! O He Who is pleaded!
O He Who is desired!

verses.arabic: رَفَضْتُ وَصِيَّتَكَ الَّتِيْ اَوْصَيْتَنِيْ وَ لَمْ اُطِعْكَ
verses.translation: I have overlooked Your instructions, which You gave me and have not obeyed You.

verses.arabic: وَ لَوْ اَطَعْتُكَ فِيْمَا اَمَرْتَنِيْ لَكَفَيْتَنِيْ مَا قُمْتُ اِلَيْكَ فِيْهِ
verses.translation: If I obeyed You in what You have ordered me, You would certainly grant my requests that I am presenting before You.

verses.arabic: وَ اَنَا مَعَ مَعْصِيَّتِيْ لَكَ رَاجٍ،
verses.translation: In spite of my transgression, I am hopeful for You.

verses.arabic: فَلَا تَحُلْ بَيْنِيْ وَ بَيْنَ مَا رَجَوْتُ
verses.translation: So, do not let my hope remain unfulfilled.

verses.arabic: يَا مُتَرَحِّمًا لِيْ اَعِذْنِيْ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَ مِنْ خَلْفِيْ
verses.translation: O He Who always has mercy upon me, keep me safe, under Your protection, from (all evils that are) before me, behind me,

verses.arabic: وَ مِنْ فَوْقِي وَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
verses.translation: above me, below me,

verses.arabic: وَ مِنْ كُلِّ جِهَاتِ الْاِحَاطَةِ بِيْ
verses.translation: and from all sides that surround me.
O Allah, [I beseech You] in the name of Muhammad, my master,
and [in the name of] 'Ali, my chief,
and [in the names of] the orthodox Imams (leaders), peace be upon them,

verses.arabic: اِجْعَلْ عَلَيْنَا صَلَوَاتِكَ وَ رَأْفَتَكَ وَ رَحْمَتَكَ
verses.translation: (please) bestow upon us with Your blessings, compassions, and mercy;
and grant us expansive shares of Your sustenance;

verses.arabic: وَ اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَ جَمِيْعَ حَوَاۤئِجِنَا
verses.translation: and help us repay our debts and settle all our needs,

verses.arabic: يَا اَللهُ يَا اَللهُ يَا اَللهُ
verses.translation: O Allah, O Allah, O Allah.
Verily, You have full power over all things.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ الْعَرَبِيِّ وَ اٰلِهِ۔
verses.translation: O Allah, send blessings to the Arab Prophet and on his Household.
